name: tiktok-shop-ads
description: TikTok Shop affiliate UGC ads — Taglish Ate Host narration, Veo hero clips with no voice-over, final ≥ 60 s of content plus a 2.5 s end card.
visual_checklist: Each clip shows its expected visual (expected_visuals), in script order, no repeated shot

THE PRODUCT MATCHES THE LISTING PHOTO in every clip it appears — shape, colour, size versus hands, logo, parts; it never morphs. A wrong-looking product is a FAIL (it misrepresents what the buyer gets)
No text, subtitles, watermark or stray logos (only what is printed on the product itself)
Hands: five fingers each, plausible grip, slow simple actions
The Ate Host looks the same in every clip (face, hair, grey t-shirt, no jewellery)
Lip check: only the on-screen host moves her lips, in sync with her words; bystanders keep lips closed; when the host is off-screen nobody on screen moves their lips
Hero clips (no voice-over) have no one talking
